mapper.sql:
SELECT M.OFC_CODE, O.KANM, M.MCN_NO, RTRIM(M.INST_PST_CODE) AS INST_PST_CODE, P.INST_PST_NM, M.SRC, S.SRC_NM, M.KOM_TYPE, M.VEND_CODE,
C.CODE_NM AS VEND_NM,
NULL AS VEND_NM,
RTRIM(M.OP_TYPE) AS OP_TYPE, RTRIM(M.INOUT_TYPE) AS INOUT_TYPE, M.USE_YN, RTRIM(M.CNR_PST_SPEC_CODE) AS CNR_PST_SPEC_CODE, M.CRT_DTM, M.CRT_CMENO, M.LSCHG_DTM, M.LS_CMENO FROM TB_MCN_INFO M LEFT JOIN TB_OFC_REG_MGT O ON O.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_SCRT_INST_PST P ON P.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE AND P.INST_PST_CODE = RTRIM(M.INST_PST_CODE) LEFT JOIN TB_NMS_SRC S ON S.SRC = M.SRC
LEFT JOIN TB_CO_CODE C ON C.CODE_TYPE = #{vendorCodeType} AND C.CODE = M.VEND_CODE

WHERE M.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{s.ofcCode} AS CHAR(6))
AND M.MCN_NO = CAST(#{s.mcnNo} AS CHAR(3))
AND M.VEND_CODE = #{s.vendCode}
AND M.KOM_TYPE = #{s.komType}
AND M.OP_TYPE = CAST(#{s.opType} AS CHAR(1))
AND M.INOUT_TYPE = CAST(#{s.inoutType} AS CHAR(1))
AND M.USE_YN = CAST(#{s.useYn} AS CHAR(1))
mapper.select: ORDER BY M.OFC_CODE, M.MCN_NO OFFSET #{s.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{s.limit} ROWS ONLY
WHERE M.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND M.MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MCN_INFO WHERE OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MCN_INFO ( OFC_CODE, MCN_NO, INST_PST_CODE, SRC, KOM_TYPE, VEND_CODE, OP_TYPE, INOUT_TYPE, USE_YN, CNR_PST_SPEC_CODE, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{ofcCode}, #{mcnNo}, #{instPstCode}, #{src}, #{komType}, #{vendCode}, #{opType}, #{inoutType}, #{useYn}, #{cnrPstSpecCode}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MCN_INFO SET INST_PST_CODE = #{instPstCode}, SRC = #{src}, KOM_TYPE = #{komType}, VEND_CODE = #{vendCode}, OP_TYPE = #{opType}, INOUT_TYPE = #{inoutType}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, CNR_PST_SPEC_CODE = #{cnrPstSpecCode}, LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3))
UPDATE TB_MCN_INFO SET USE_YN = 'N', LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) AND MCN_NO = CAST(#{mcnNo} AS CHAR(3))
